<?php
class C { public int $x=1; public int $y=2; }
$out=[];
foreach([false,true] as $proxy) {
 $r=new ReflectionClass(C::class);$x=$r->getProperty('x');$y=$r->getProperty('y');$running=[];
 $init=function($o) use($proxy,$x,$y,&$running) { $running=[$x->isLazy($o),$y->isLazy($o)]; return $proxy ? new C : null; };
 $o=$proxy?$r->newLazyProxy($init):$r->newLazyGhost($init);
 $row=[[$x->isLazy($o),$y->isLazy($o)]];
 $x->setRawValueWithoutLazyInitialization($o,42);$row[]=[$x->isLazy($o),$y->isLazy($o)];
 unset($o->x);$row[]=[$x->isLazy($o),$y->isLazy($o)];$row[]=$o->y;$row[]=$running;$row[]=[$x->isLazy($o),$y->isLazy($o)];$out[]=$row;
}
echo json_encode($out),"\n";
